trio.authority: Private research comparing the identical race rows and 1/4/8 budget on each candidate. Earliest archive chronological, not prospective. Nov21–24 current model full-distribution replay. True today forward separate.

same_set_diagnostic.posthoc_diagnostic: Correct 3-rider set supplied after outcome only; compare each conditional exact order within 6 permutations. The forecast model did not observe this input.

weather_airport.method: Full equal-point pooled-probability re-ranking with longitude and crosswise pre-cutoff airport winds, never race result weather. Schedule version saved after race in archive; future validation absent. One outdoor track and short periods.
weather_airport.source_noaa: NOAA access index did not expose 2026 CSV. IEM ordinary API returned explicit HTTP 429; the valid Haneda archived METAR rows only were counted after rate limit. No alternate access to IEM attempted after observing 429.

weather_jma.scope: Separate extension using only observed hourly JMA winds, no METAR pool. Archived race schedules and normalized payouts are retrospective, not prospective forecast commitments.
